verdict.rationale: Consensus documents semantic search that captures intent and supports natural-language queries. Threads turn searches into ongoing conversations, and a research agent chains citation crawling, DOI lookup, author search and similar-paper discovery from a user's question. Together these cover operating the core research workflow in plain language. Missing for 10: evidence that non-search operations (library import/management, filter settings) can be driven by natural-language commands, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor claims.
